rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Ice is a defensible substance description for deposited frost crystals and refrigerator fine ice; this is a direct supplied definition, not an unrestricted hypernym policy.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Frost is not a replacement for every ice mass, hailstone or shaved ice; the overlapping fine-ice region nevertheless warrants a direct guard.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Required direct guard; no assertion that every form of ice is frost.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: The freeze/frozen label reaches the frozen deposit explicitly defined for frost, including refrigerator frost.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Frost does not translate every freezing event, chilled body or congealing material. The specific frozen-deposit overlap is enough for a precaution in either option direction.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Required direct guard, not frost-heave/permafrost English extrapolation or a universal freezing synonym.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Aid/assistance can describe the directly protective saving/helping region of guarding; KANJIDIC2 援 explicitly includes save. The complete 援 article independently retains rescue/protection.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Guard/defense is defensible for protective rescue or covering from attack, not for general financial assistance, cheering or merely drawing something toward oneself.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Required qualified direct guard. Complete 援護 family retains its 援護-only help restriction and its separate unrestricted protection sense; no third-card transitivity.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Cycle is defensible for the unrestricted going-around branch 周りをまわる/取り巻く, reinforced by the historical メグル lookup; it is not restricted to satellites orbiting a centre.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Guard/defense is not a definition of following a sequence. Going around can reach 衛's circling branch, while ordinary sequential following need not guard anything.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Required direct precaution for partial circling overlap, not a generic follow/defend equation.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Alcohol/sake is a direct answer for the independently listed bare 霜しも jargon sense 酒類一切, not an inference from white appearance or a compound.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Frost is not an ordinary definition of 酒. The broad alcoholic-drink sense overlaps the explicitly attested jargon denotation in the opposite direction.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified precaution for a compilation of Meiji-and-later jargon; not proof of ordinary modern 霜 usage. No additional reading/practice key.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Clear; sharp-minded is not a defensible answer for frost deposits, white hair, elapsed years, powdered preparation, loss or the white/cold/sharp/severe comparisons. Sharpness of an edge/severity is not mental alertness or clarity; the shared English stem does not establish that sense.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Frost (the noun taught here: deposited ice) is not a definition of clearness, skill, wakefulness, appearance or the older becoming-frigid sense. Even 冴's complete KANJIDIC2 こおる/ひえる inventory describes freezing/cold, not that deposited substance. Weather capable of producing frost is not the noun frost.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Bounded non-collision for these actual displayed labels and complete opened senses only. Positive old-fashioned frigid/intensely-cold sense in 1297050, rare 冴寒, KD cold/freezing keys and Spanish freezing gloss remain; no assertion that the two characters never share cold-related contexts.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Cool can be a defensible broad label for the explicitly listed cold-things comparison, although pleasant refreshing coolness is narrower than severe cold.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Frost is not an ordinary gloss of cooling oneself, clear eyes, composure or refreshing air. This direct precaution protects the broad cool/cold label region rather than erasing those distinctions.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified precaution, not an inference through 冷/寒 or an assertion that every cool breeze is frost.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: A long time can describe the attested elapsed-years としつき/年月/歴年 branch; the duration is positive source evidence, not merely an old-looking frosty object.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Frost does not define every long interval, old story or eternity. The direct safeguard covers broad elapsed-time answers without turning all durations into weather.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified precaution; not transitive through 年/歴 and not a claim that every elapsed year is necessarily a long time.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Harm/damage can be a broad answer for the independently listed loss/perishing branch, but the exact historical reach of うしなう is not settled by the primary weather noun.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Frost does not ordinarily define injury, damage or evil influence. The source-positive destructive/loss region gets a precaution, not a new assertion that 霜害 allocates all harm to bare 霜.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified lexical-allocation precaution, not frost-causes-damage reasoning or an inference through 損.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Wither can be a defensible special case of the positive perishing branch when plants perish; the exact scope remains qualified.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Frost is not the ordinary definition of withering, personality maturation or seasoning lumber. KD 枯 die and complete 枯れる die are retained, so the death/perishing region is protected directly.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified precaution from independent perishing/death evidence, not an allocation from the compound 霜枯れ or from a third-card 死 guard.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Kill is not automatically equivalent to intransitive perish. The positive うしなう/loss branch and historical destructive explanation leave the breadth toward destructive kill uncertain, so a direct safeguard is preferable to asserting a clean non-collision.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Frost is not the ordinary definition of murder, suppressing a voice, spoiling talent/flavour, baseball putting-out or pawning. All complete 殺す secondary senses remain; none proves that every such action belongs to bare 霜.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified precaution, not a taught general kill sense. Image gaps in the historical quotation remain; no invented glyph reading, frost-kills-plants causal proof, or 討/死 transitivity.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Finish can be a loose answer for a life's ending in the positive perishing branch; graduation is not a frost sense.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Frost does not ordinarily mean graduating, completing a task, a soldier or formal death. The actual retained 卒する formal death and 卒る ending families support a qualified life-ending precaution.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified precaution; preserves search-only 卒える and rare 卒る distinctions, not unrestricted ordinary spellings or a transitive 衛/卒/亡 chain.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Turn in a series is not a primary defense definition, but a guard's turn on watch can be described that way; protect rather than assume the short title exhausts 番.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Guard is an explicit ordinary sense of bare 番 in complete 2022640, alongside watch/lookout; thus 衛's displayed label is directly defensible. The pair/joint and numbering senses remain separate.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified direct precaution; stronger independent bare-word evidence than 当番 alone, no watch-guard transitivity.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Warrior can describe the military guard-person region, though neither every guard nor every professional is a warrior.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Guard/defense can be defensible for the military-retainer role in the historical 士/侍 warrior family; not for every licensed professional or respected man.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified role-overlap precaution based on the directly attested guard-person/military branch, not transfer through 兵 or 卒.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Troops can be a defensible broad description of the collective military guarding region in 守るもの、宿衛、軍衛. This does not allocate every compound sense to 衛.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Guard/defense is defensible for troops acting as a protective military guard, not every army, war/battle, team or military authority. Bare 軍 and its unmarked いくさ war sense remain in full.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified collective-role precaution rather than proof that bare 衛 universally means army; compound allocation remains limited, with no 兵/卒 chain.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Escort can describe guarding someone while accompanying them. Complete 護衛/衛護 corroborate that use but are not the sole basis for assigning unrestricted escort to bare 衛.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Guard is defensible for a protective escort, but not every ordinary 送る taking-home, mail dispatch, funeral, passing time or okurigana action includes protection.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified protective-function precaution grounded in guarding; bare-constituent allocation is not asserted from compounds alone. 贈る gift remains separate.

rows.comparisonLabelOnTarget: Resist can be defensible for warding off an attack under the explicit ふせぐ branch, not a meaning inferred through 防.
rows.targetLabelOnComparison: Guard/defense can describe protective resistance, not every collision, contact, reluctance, electrical resistance, mortgage or approximate amount.
rows.qualificationAndResidualLimits: Qualified direct precaution for warding-off/opposition, not a claim that every resistance is defensive.

supersession: Addendum only for these 17 pairs. Original source/scans/decisions remain immutable historical evidence; all other finite dispositions stay bounded and unchanged.
criterion: Both actual displayed-label directions assessed using complete opened comparison articles, complete relevant families and positive secondary/historical sources. Direct declarations work symmetrically and are never transitive.
status: Author dispositions awaiting two independent original-family confirmations; no publication acceptance.
limits: Precautions are not proven universal synonymy. Q2 is bounded to opened senses, not a whole-index absence claim. Historical, rare, supplemental, native-word, name, register and allocation limits are retained.
